sloka: उत्पपात रजो घोरं तैर्भग्नैः सम्प्रधावितैः।न हि तत्सहितुं शेकुर्ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं स्वयम् ।। ६.१००.९ ।।
transliteration: utpapāta rajo ghoraṁ tairbhagnaiḥ sampradhāvitaiḥ।na hi tatsahituṁ śekurbrahmaṇā nirmitaṁ svayam ।। 6.100.9 ।।

translations.english: As the Taamasa missile had been built and bestowed by Brahma, the monkeys were unable to bear and by their running dust had risen.
